title: Past Simple: spelling & negatives
grammarNote:
В прошлом уроке мы изучили базовое правило: глагол + -ed. Но у некоторых глаголов есть ОСОБЫЕ правила написания. И теперь мы изучим, как делать ОТРИЦАНИЕ в Past Simple.

📌 Правила написания -ed (4 правила):

① Большинство глаголов: просто + -ed
call → called · walk → walked · clean → cleaned · watch → watched

② Глагол оканчивается на -e: просто + -d (не -ed!)
practise → practised · arrive → arrived · use → used · like → liked

③ Глагол оканчивается на согласная + -y: замени -y на -i, добавь -ed
study → studied · try → tried · carry → carried · hurry → hurried
(Но: play → played · stay → stayed — гласная + y, правило не применяется!)

④ Короткий глагол (согл. + гласн. + согл.): удвой последнюю согласную + -ed
stop → stopped · plan → planned · shop → shopped · jog → jogged

❌ ОТРИЦАНИЕ в Past Simple:
Didn't + [base form глагола] (НИКОГДА с -ed!)
"I didn't clean." (НЕ "I didn't cleaned.")
"She didn't cook." (НЕ "She didn't cooked.")

Почему? Потому что "did" уже показывает прошедшее время — глагол после didn't всегда в БАЗОВОЙ форме!

grammarTable.subject: ① + -ed (обычный)
grammarTable.example: called · walked · cleaned · watched · listened · stayed · talked

grammarTable.subject: ② + -d (на -e)
grammarTable.example: practised · arrived · liked · used · moved · decided · smiled

grammarTable.subject: ③ согл.+y → -ied
grammarTable.example: studied · tried · carried · hurried · worried · replied · tidied

grammarTable.subject: ④ СГС → удвой + -ed
grammarTable.example: stopped · planned · shopped · jogged · dropped · preferred · admitted

grammarTable.subject: Didn't + base form (–)
grammarTable.example: I didn't clean. · She didn't cook. · We didn't walk. · They didn't study.

grammarTable.subject: ⚠️ Частая ошибка:
grammarTable.example: ❌ "She didn't cooked." → ✅ "She didn't cook." (base form — без -ed!)

rows.example: call → call-ED · clean → clean-ED · watch → watch-ED · listen → listen-ED · help → help-ED
practis-E → practisED · arriv-E → arrivED · lik-E → likED · us-E → usED · smil-E → smilED
❌ "practise-ed" ❌ "like-ed" → ✅ "practised" ✅ "liked" (только -d, не -ed!)
stud-Y → studIED · tr-Y → trIED · carr-Y → carrIED · hurr-Y → hurrIED · worr-Y → worrIED
play → played (a+y) ✅ · stay → stayed (a+y) ✅ · enjoy → enjoyed (o+y) ✅ — НЕ playied!

st-O-p → stopped · pl-A-n → planned · sh-O-p → shopped · jo-G → jogged
⚠️ НЕ удваивай если 2+ гласных: look → looked (не lookked!)
"I didn't clean my room." · "She didn't cook." · "We didn't walk to the park."
"He didn't study." ✅ (не "He doesn't studied" ✅). В прошлом — всегда didn't!
❌ "I didn't cleaned." ❌ "She didn't cooked." → ✅ "I didn't clean." ✅ "She didn't cook."

rows.form: Почему BASE FORM? Потому что DID = уже прошедшее:
rows.example: "did" уже несёт значение прошедшего времени → глагол после него в базовой форме. didn't = did + not.

rows.form: Примеры из диалога Bekzhan и Yerlan:
rows.example: "Bekzhan didn't walk to the park." · "He didn't cook anything." · "He didn't leave his room."
"I did not finish the essay." = "I didn't finish the essay." — оба правильны, didn't более разговорно.

grammarExtra.title: ③ Типичные ошибки — разбор и исправление

rows.example: → ✅ "She studied last weekend." (study+y с согл. перед y → studied)
→ ✅ "I didn't clean my room." (base form после didn't — без -ed!)
→ ✅ "He stopped at the market." (stop — СГС правило → double p → stopped)
→ ✅ "They enjoyed the weekend." (enjoy → enjoyed — гласная+y → просто -ed, не -ied!)
→ ✅ "She practised English." (practise оканчивается на -e → только + d, не + ed)
→ ✅ "Bekzhan didn't study last Sunday." (прошлое → didn't, не doesn't!)

grammarExtra.title: ④ didn't vs wasn't/weren't — чем отличаются?

rows.example: "I didn't clean." · "She didn't cook." · "We didn't walk to the park." (действия)
"The weather wasn't cold." · "They weren't tired." · "I wasn't at home." (состояния, was/were = to be)
"I didn't study." (не учился — действие) vs "I wasn't at university." (не был там — местонахождение/состояние)
❌ "I didn't tired yesterday." → ✅ "I wasn't tired yesterday." (tired — прилагательное → was/were)
"Bekzhan didn't cook." (действие) · "Bekzhan wasn't happy about his weekend." (состояние)
Глагол ДЕЙСТВИЯ → didn't · Глагол "быть" (be) / прилагательное → wasn't / weren't

grammarTip:
Четыре шага для идеального Past Simple:

① Выбери правило написания -ed:
   Обычный → + ed: walk → walked
   На -e → + d: arrive → arrived
   Согл. + y → -ied: study → studied
   Короткий СГС → удвой: stop → stopped

② Проверь: гласная + y = просто -ed!
   play → played ✅ (НЕ playied!) · stay → stayed ✅

③ Для отрицания: DIDN'T + BASE FORM (без -ed!)
   "I didn't clean." ✅ · "She didn't cook." ✅
   ❌ "I didn't cleaned." ❌ "She didn't cooked."

④ Не путай didn't и wasn't:
   Действие → didn't + verb: "I didn't study."
   Состояние → wasn't/weren't: "I wasn't tired."

💡 Тест на ошибку:
Если после didn't есть -ed → ОШИБКА! Убери -ed!
"She didn't studied." ❌ → "She didn't study." ✅

exercises.text: Aruzhan ___ English every summer before coming to WKU.
exercises.hint: study → consonant (d) + y → change y to i, add -ed: studied ✅. NOT "studyed" — the rule applies because "d" before y is a consonant.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Yerlan ___ (practise) cooking at his grandmother's every summer.
exercises.hint: practise ends in -e → just add -d: practised ✅. NOT "practiseed" — verb ends in -e, so only +d!

exercises.text: Bekzhan ___ leave his room all weekend — he studied the whole time.
exercises.hint: "didn't" + BASE FORM! "leave" is the base form. ❌ "didn't left" — NEVER use past form after didn't!

exercises.text: "She didn't cooked dinner last night" is correct English.
exercises.hint: NEVER use -ed after didn't! → "She didn't COOK dinner last night." ✅ (base form, no -ed after didn't)

exercises.text: Saule ___ over her tea when she laughed too hard during the film.
exercises.hint: spill → ends in double -ll (not CVC rule) → just add -ed: spilled ✅. (British English also accepts "spilt" but "spilled" is standard.)
"last Sunday" = past → didn't (not doesn't) ✅. After didn't → BASE FORM: study (not studied!) ✅.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Aruzhan ___ (stop) at the market and bought apples on her way back.
exercises.hint: stop → CVC rule (s-t-o-p: consonant-vowel-consonant, 1 syllable) → double the p → stopped ✅. NOT "stoped"!

exercises.text: Aruzhan describes her Sunday. Which sentence is correct?
opts: "I was play card games all evening."
"I played cards, but I didn't watch TV."
exercises.correct: "I played cards, but I didn't watch TV."
exercises.hint: "played" ✅ (play → +ed, regular). "didn't watch" ✅ (base form after didn't). Others: "was play" ❌, "didn't was" ❌, "plaied" ❌ (play+ed, not play+ied — vowel+y!).
